flags.text: Says prior evidence suggests negative ads are 'less effective for Democrats'. The paper says Democrats tend to respond more to positive ads than Republicans do (p.2); the evidence that negative ads do not aid election success is the meta-analysis, which the claim does not state.

interlocutor_claim.note: Labels such as 'criminal' worsen perceptions of people with records (I1, p.2). Disputing the party's strategy is the neutral I-b1.
